Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — constrains n to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with one decimal place (B, KB, MB, GB)
3. **`loadSettings(filePath)`** in src/settings.js — reads and parses JSON, applies defaults for missing keys, throws AppError if the file is missing or JSON is malformed

All functions are exported from their respective modules.
